provenance.solver: Gmsh linear tetrahedra; SciPy sparse P1 Laplace FEM

scope.model: Idealized steady potential flow through the native intake gas domain
scope.boundary: Upstream caps potential1; open head-side caps0; closed caps and walls natural no-flux. Outlet mask1=right,2=left,3=both
scope.advection: Volume-weighted recovered FEM nodal gradient, tetrahedral interpolation and midpoint integration; accepted paths independently contained in all six native B-rep gas solids
scope.speed: Illustrative100mm/s median field magnitude; no measured mass flow, pressure, turbulence, temperature or valve-cycle coupling
limitations: No viscous losses, compressibility, turbulence or wall boundary layer
Only accepted outlet-reaching tracers are displayed; this is not a mass-flux-proportional sampling
Constant supplied inlet potential and outlet potential; no time-resolved valve boundary
